criteria.h1: The watch-list entry h1 (Marlow Finch Trading Ltd, GB) is the applicant
criteria.none_of_these: None of the entries is the applicant: registration number, address and directors differ
criteria.cannot_tell: The records conflict or are missing, so a person must decide

match.instructions: Compare state.applicant with each watch-list entry in state.hits and its registry record in state.registry. Which entry, if any, is the applicant? The same registration number or the same directors and address mean it is.
